title: West Bengal withdraws appeal in Supreme Court against removal of 77 communities from OBC list
description: The West Bengal government on Tuesday withdrew from Supreme Court its appeal challenging Calcutta High Court's verdict striking down the inclusion of 77 communities, predominantly 75 Muslim communities, in the State’s Other Backward Classes (OBC) list.A Bench of Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana permitted the withdrawal.
